advisory.heading: When you write the body
advisory.text: You can also start the value on the next line after `|` or `>`.
advisory.problem: In /Users/alexk/Projects/agent-context/skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 20, this sentence gives a second method next to the quotation marks, but line 24 already recommends one line in quotation marks for `description`, and line 21 permits no other field with free text.

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: In the frontmatter, write no top-level field other than `name`, `description`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, and `allowed-tools`.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 18 (and lines 21 to 23, 43), the technical noun "field" is not a term of the base list in technical-terms.md and not a term of GLOSSARY.md.
advisory.correction: Keep the sentence, and add a warning that recommends a base-list term: "field | One key and its value in the frontmatter or in a YAML file | "property", "attribute"".

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Write each key and each value in `metadata` as text.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 19 (and lines 20, 24, 28, 44), the technical nouns "key" and "value" are not terms of the base list in technical-terms.md and not terms of GLOSSARY.md.
advisory.correction: Keep the sentence, and add a warning that recommends 2 base-list terms: "key | The name of a field in YAML" and "value | The data after the key of a field in YAML".

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Write frontmatter that the YAML parser reads with no errors.

advisory.correction: "Write frontmatter that is correct YAML, so that `skills-ref validate` gives no errors."

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: A Skills folder of the project is a folder from this table that the project has.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md line 73 (and line 11 and the heading on line 71), the technical noun "Skills folder" is not a term of the base list in technical-terms.md and not a term of GLOSSARY.md.

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: Each rule starts with its tier.
advisory.problem: Line 3 of agent-skills-spec.md tells that each rule starts with its tier, but the rules on line 11 ("Select the Skills folder of the project first"), line 50 ("When the user gives text for the description, keep the meaning of that text."), and line 73 (the rule "ask the user one time which folder to use" and the rule "add a warning") start with no tier.
advisory.correction: Start each of these rules with its tier, for example "Tier 4: When the user gives text for the description, keep the meaning of that text." Or change line 3 to "Each rule in a list starts with its tier."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use.
advisory.problem: Line 73 of agent-skills-spec.md puts a fact, a pointer, a tier 1 rule, a definition, and 2 more rules in one paragraph with one mark "(advisory)" at its end, so the reader cannot see the sequence of the steps or which rule has the tier and the mark.
advisory.correction: Write the steps as a numbered list, with one tier and one mark for each step: "1. Find the target platforms as `loading-rules.md` tells you. 2. Tier 1: When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project. 3. If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use. 4. For each Skill that you write for these target platforms, add a warning that gives the platform that does not load the Skill." Keep the facts and the definition before the list.

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: The word rules are not applicable to quoted text, and it counts as 1 word.
advisory.problem: Line 53 of agent-skills-spec.md repeats ste-rules.md line 13 (the word rules are not applicable to user phrases in quotation marks) and line 82 (quoted text counts as 1 word), and step 7 of SKILL.md tells the agent to read ste-rules.md before it writes text.
advisory.correction: Remove the sentence "The word rules are not applicable to quoted text, and it counts as 1 word."

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: Tier 4: Move long text to files in the folder of the Skill or in a folder directly in the folder of the Skill.
advisory.problem: Line 63 of agent-skills-spec.md permits a reference file directly in the folder of the Skill, but item 4 on line 67 of loading-rules.md tells the agent to put a reference file of a Skill in `<skill>/references/<name>.md`, so the two files give different places for the same file.
advisory.correction: "Tier 4: Move long text to reference files in `<skill>/references/`. For each file, tell when to read it."
